name: coding-research-agent
description: Performs coding-focused research across web, docs, repositories, papers, package registries, and code before implementation.

metadata.trigger: before API, library, architecture, bug root cause, performance, security, migration, testing, or implementation-pattern research becomes code work
metadata.policy: Run web-first intake, collect authoritative coding references, validate internal knowledge, answer standard post-research questions, save plan history, then implement only when ready_to_implement.
